description: Search open jobs on DomDom Jobs: robot training and teleoperation (robots), remote nursing, telehealth and therapy (healthcare), UX research and design (ux), side jobs for evenings and weekends (moonlight), jobs for veterans (veterans) and remote legal work (legal). Filter names match the boards' own filters. Returns each job's DomDom page (hub_url), the employer's application link, pay as posted, and a browse_url that opens the same filtered list on the board. Newest first, at most two jobs per employer at the top. Every keyword must appear in the title or employer, so use one to three words.

board.description: home searches every board; the others are robots, healthcare, ux, moonlight, veterans and legal.

employer.description: Employer name or slug, e.g. "Mercor" or "mercor".

employment.description: Employment type, where the posting states one.

pay.description: Hourly jobs whose top posted rate reaches this many US dollars an hour.

posted.description: Only jobs posted in the last 7 days.

query.description: Words to match in the job title or employer name, e.g. "ICU", "paralegal".

type.description: Type of work: a hub key on the chosen board, e.g. nurses (healthcare), lawyers (legal), weekends (moonlight), operator (robots). See list_boards.

who.description: Who can apply to a remote job: US only, the countries the posting names, or worldwide.

name: search_jobs
title: Search DomDom Jobs
